prediction: The head of faith is the abasement in speech and the multiplication in action. He whose words exceed his deeds, know ye that his non-existence is better than his existence, and his annihilation is preferable to his continuance.

input: اصل العافیة هی الصّمت و النّظر الی العاقبة و الانزوآء عن البریّة.
output: The essence of true safety is to observe silence, to look at the end of things and to renounce the world.
prediction: The essence of deliverance lieth in silence, and looking to the outcome, and retiring from the world.

input: رأس الهمّة هی انفاق المرء علی نفسه و علی اهله و الفقرآء من اخوته فی دینه.
output: The beginning of magnanimity is when man expendeth his wealth on himself, on his family and on the poor among his brethren in his Faith.
prediction: The essence of zeal lies in a person's expenditure upon himself and his family, and upon the destitute among his brethren in religion.

input: رأس التّجارة هی حبّی به یستغنی کلّ شیء عن کلّ شیء و بدونه یفتقر کلّ شیء عن کلّ شیء و هذا ما رقم من اصبع عزّ منیر.
output: The essence of wealth is love for Me; whoso loveth Me is the possessor of all things, and he that loveth Me not is indeed of the poor and needy. This is that which the Finger of Glory and Splendor hath revealed.
prediction: The head of commerce is My love, whereby everything is rendered self-sufficient, and without which everything is destitute. This is that which none can measure from the tip of Thy glorious luster.

input: اصل کلّ الشّرّ هو اغفال العبد عن مولاه و اقباله الی ما سواه.
output: The source of all evil is for man to turn away from his Lord and set his heart on things ungodly.
prediction: The root of every evil is the neglect of the servant towards his Lord, and his turning away from Him to that which is other than Him.

input: اصل النّار هی الجحاد فی آیات الله و المجادلة بمن ینزل من عنده و الانکار به و الاستکبار علیه.
output: The most burning fire is to question the signs of God, to dispute idly that which He hath revealed, to deny Him and carry one's self proudly before Him.
prediction: The root of the fire is kindling in the verses of God, and disputing with those who are sent forth from Him, and denying and arrogance towards Him.

input: اصل کلّ العلوم هو عرفان الله جلّ جلاله و هذا لن یحقّق الّا بعرفان مظهر نفسه.
output: The source of all learning is the knowledge of God, exalted be His glory, and this cannot be attained save through the knowledge of His Divine Manifestation.
prediction: The foundation of all sciences is the knowledge of God, exalted be His glory, and this can be attained only through the recognition of His Manifestation.

input: رأس الذّلّة هی الخروج عن ظلّ الرّحمن و الدّخول فی ظلّ الشّیطان.
output: The essence of abasement is to pass out from under the shadow of the Merciful and seek the shelter of the Evil One.
prediction: The head of humiliation is to emerge from the shade of the All-Merciful and to enter into the shadow of Satan.

input: رأس الکفر هو الشّرک بالله و الاعتماد علی سواه و الفرار عن قضایاه.
output: The source of error is to disbelieve in the One true God, rely upon aught else but Him, and flee from His Decree.
prediction: The head of unbelief is the association of partners with God and reliance upon others, and the fleeing from His decrees.

input: اصل الخسران لمن مضت ایّامه و ما عرف نفسه.
output: True loss is for him whose days have been spent in utter ignorance of his self.
prediction: O essence of failure, for him whose days have passed and who hath not known himself.

input: رأس کلّ ما اذکرناه لک هو الانصاف و هو خروج العبد عن الوهم و التّقلید و التّفرّس فی مظاهر الصّنع بنظر التّوحید و المشاهدة فی کلّ الأمور بالبصر الحدید.
output: The essence of all that We have revealed for thee is Justice, is for man to free himself from idle fancy and imitation, discern with the eye of oneness His glorious handiwork, and look into all things with a searching eye.
prediction: Say, O my God, verily the essence of all that We have mentioned for thee is justice, and it is the emergence of the servant from the realm of illusion and imitation, and beholding the manifestations of creation with the eye of unity and perception in all things with iron-sighted vision.

input: کذلک علّمناک و صرّفنا لک کلمات الحکمة لتشکر الله ربّک فی نفسک و تفتخر بها بین العالمین.
output: Thus have We instructed thee, manifested unto thee Words of Wisdom, that thou mayest be thankful unto the Lord, thy God, and glory therein amidst all peoples.
prediction: Thus have We taught thee and turned unto thee the words of wisdom, that thou mayest render thanks to God, thy Lord, within thine own soul, and exalt them among all the peoples.

input: لوح کرمل
output: i-Karmil Tablet of Carmel
prediction: Tablet of Carmel

input: اذاً نادت الأشیآء و عن ورائها الملأ الأعلی یا کرمل انزلی بما اقبل الیک وجه الله مالک ملکوت الأسمآء و فاطر السّمآء.
output: Thereupon the voices of all created things, and beyond them those of the Concourse on High, were heard calling aloud: Haste thee, O Carmel, for lo, the light of the countenance of God, the Ruler of the Kingdom of Names and Fashioner of the heavens, hath been lifted upon thee.
prediction: Then the things cried out, and behind them the Concourse on high, O Thou Most Merciful, descend with faces turned towards God, the Sovereign of the Kingdom of Names and the Creator of the heavens.

input: اذاً اخذها اهتزاز السّرور و نادت بأعلی النّدآء نفسی لاقبالک الفدآء و لعنایتک الفدآء و لتوجّهک الفدآء.
output: Seized with transports of joy, and raising high her voice, she thus exclaimed: May my life be a sacrifice to Thee, inasmuch as Thou hast fixed Thy gaze upon me, hast bestowed upon me Thy bounty, and hast directed towards me Thy steps.
prediction: Then was she seized with the tremor of joy, and cried out with the highest cry her soul for Thy ransom, and for Thy grace, and for Thy favor.

input: قد اهلکنی یا مطلع الحیوة فراقک و احرقنی هجرک.
output: Separation from Thee, O Thou Source of everlasting life, hath well nigh consumed me, and my remoteness from Thy presence hath burned away my soul.
prediction: Verily, O Dayspring of Life, hath thy separation destroyed me, and thy neglect hath consumed me.

input: لک الحمد بما اسمعتنی ندائک و شرّفتنی بقدومک و احییتنی من نفحات آیاتک و صریر قلمک الّذی جعلته صوراً بین عبادک.
output: All praise be to Thee for having enabled me to hearken to Thy call, for having honored me with Thy footsteps, and for having quickened my soul through the vitalizing fragrance of Thy Day and the shrilling voice of Thy Pen, a voice Thou didst ordain as Thy trumpet-call amidst Thy people.
prediction: Praised be Thou, O my God, that Thou hast inclined mine ear to Thy voice, and honored me with Thy coming, and quickened me with the breathings of Thy signs, and hast caused the Pen which Thou hast made to manifest itself among Thy servants to speak in divers forms.

input: فلمّا جآء امرک المبرم نفخت فیه اذاً قامت القیامة الکبری و ظهرت الأسرار المکنونة فی خزائن مالک الأشیآء.
output: And when the hour at which Thy resistless Faith was to be made manifest did strike, Thou didst breathe a breath of Thy spirit into Thy Pen, and lo, the entire creation shook to its very foundations, unveiling to mankind such mysteries as lay hidden within the treasuries of Him Who is the Possessor of all created things.
prediction: When Thy most firmly established Command came, then didst Thou blow thereunto, and lo, the Great Resurrection arose, and the hidden mysteries were disclosed in the treasuries of the Lord of creatures.

input: طوبی لک بما جعلک الله فی هذا الیوم مقرّ عرشه و مطلع آیاته و مشرق بیّناته.
output: Rejoice, for God hath in this Day established upon thee His throne, hath made thee the dawning-place of His signs and the dayspring of the evidences of His Revelation.
prediction: Great is thy blessedness, O Thou whom God hath made this day the seat of His throne, and the dawning-place of His signs, and the horizon of His manifest proofs.

input: یا کرمل بشّری صهیون قولی اتی المکنون.
output: Call out to Zion, O Carmel, and announce the joyful tidings: He that was hidden from mortal eyes is come.
prediction: O Carmel, call out to Zion, and proclaim the word that cometh to the hidden one.

input: بسلطان غلب العالم و بنور ساطع به اشرقت الأرض و من علیها.
output: His all-conquering sovereignty is manifest. His all-encompassing splendor is revealed.
prediction: By Thy sovereign dominion that subdues the world, and through the all-encompassing light that hath illumined the earth and all that is upon it.

input: ایّاک ان تکونی متوقّفة فی مقامک.
output: Beware lest thou hesitate or halt.
prediction: O Thou Who dost abide in Thy own station.

input: اسرعی ثمّ طوفی مدینة الله الّتی نزّلت من السّمآء و کعبة الله الّتی کانت مطاف المقرّبین و المخلصین و الملائکة العالین.
output: Hasten forth and circumambulate the City of God that hath descended from heaven, the celestial Kaaba round which have circled in adoration the favored of God, the pure in heart, and the company of the most exalted angels.
prediction: Hasten forth and circumambulate the City of God that hath descended from heaven, the celestial Kaaba round which have circled in adoration the favored of God, the pure in heart, and the company of the most exalted angels.

input: و احبّ ان ابشّر کلّ بقعة من بقاع الأرض و کلّ مدینة من مدائنها بهذا الظّهور الّذی به انجذب فؤاد الطّور و نادت السّدرة الملک و الملکوت لله ربّ الأرباب هذا یوم فیه بشّر البحر البرّ و اخبره بما یظهر من بعد من عنایات الله المکنونة المستورة عن العقول و الأبصار.
output: Oh, how I long to announce unto every spot on the surface of the earth, and to carry to each one of its cities, the glad-tidings of this Revelation—a Revelation to which the heart of Sinai hath been attracted, and in whose name the Burning Bush is calling: 'Unto God, the Lord of Lords, belong the kingdoms of earth and heaven.' Verily this is the Day in which both land and sea rejoice at this announcement, the Day for which have been laid up those things which God, through a bounty beyond the ken of mortal mind or heart, hath destined for revelation.
prediction: O, how I long to announce unto every spot on the surface of the earth, and to carry to each one of its cities, the glad-tidings of this Revelation—a Revelation to which the heart of Sinai hath been attracted, and in whose name the Burning Bush is calling: 'Unto God, the Lord of Lords, belong the kingdoms of earth and heaven.' Verily this is the Day in which both land and sea rejoice at this announcement, the Day for which have been laid up those things which God, through a bounty beyond the ken of mortal mind or heart, hath destined for revelation.

input: یا بحر افرح سوف تجری سفینة الله علیک و یظهر به اهل البهآء الّذین ذکرهم فی کتاب الأسمآء.
output: Ere long will God sail His Ark upon thee, and will manifest the people of Bahá who have been mentioned in the Book of Names.
prediction: O thou Most Great Ocean, be thou exceeding glad, for ere long will God's Ark sail upon thee, and will make manifest the people of Bahá who have been mentioned in the Book of Names.

input: تبارک مولی الوری الّذی بذکره انجذبت الذّرّات و نطق لسان العظمة بما کان مکنوناً فی علمه و مخزوناً فی کنز قدرته.
output: Sanctified be the Lord of all mankind, at the mention of Whose name all the atoms of the earth have been made to vibrate, and the Tongue of Grandeur hath been moved to disclose that which had been wrapt in His knowledge and lay concealed within the treasury of His might.
prediction: Blessed be the Lord of the worlds, by Whose Remembrance the atoms were attracted, and the Tongue of Grandeur spake that which was hidden in His knowledge and treasured in the repository of His power.

input: انّه هو المهیمن علی من فی الأرض و السّمآء باسمه المقتدر العزیز المنیع.
output: He, verily, through the potency of His Name, the Mighty, the All-Powerful, the Most High, is the ruler of all that is in the heavens and all that is on earth.
prediction: Verily, He is the Sovereign of all that are in heaven and on earth, by His Name, the Mighty, the Almighty, the Insurmountable.

input: حمداً لمن تشرّف ارض البآء بقدوم من طاف حوله الأسمآء.
output: Praise be to Him Who hath honored the Land of Bá through the presence of Him round Whom all names revolve.
prediction: Praise be to Him Who hath honored the soil of Baaba with the advent of Him Whose Names encircle Him.

input: بذلک بشّرت الذّرّات کلّ الممکنات بما طلع و لاح و ظهر و اشرق و خرج من باب السّجن و افقه شمس جمال غصن الله الأعظم العظیم و سرّ الله الأقوم القدیم متوجّهاً الی مقام آخر.
output: All the atoms of the earth have announced unto all created things that from behind the gate of the Prison-city there hath appeared and above its horizon there hath shone forth the Orb of the beauty of the great, the Most Mighty Branch of God—His ancient and immutable Mystery—proceeding on its way to another land.
prediction: By that token, the atoms of all created things were foretold of that which hath shone forth, appeared, manifested itself, and shed its radiance, and emerged from the door of the prison and the horizon of God’s Most Great Branch, the Sun of Beauty, and the Ancient Hidden Mystery, setting its face towards another station.

input: بذلک تکدّرت ارض السّجن و فرحت اخری.
output: Sorrow, thereby, hath enveloped this Prison-city, whilst another land rejoiceth.
prediction: Thereby didst Thou cause the earth of the Prison to quake and bring about another joy.

input: تعالی تعالی ربّنا فاطر السّمآء و خالق الأشیآء الّذی بسلطانه فتح باب السّجن لیظهر ما انزله فی الألواح من قبل.
output: Exalted, immeasurably exalted is our Lord, the Fashioner of the heavens and the Creator of all things, He through Whose sovereignty the doors of the prison were opened, thereby causing what was promised aforetime in the Tablets to be fulfilled.
prediction: Arise, arise, O our Lord, Sovereign of the heavens and Creator of all things, Who, through Thy sovereignty, didst open the prison door that the contents of what Thou didst reveal in the Tablets might be made manifest.

input: انّه لهو المقتدر علی ما یشآء و فی قبضته ملکوت الانشآء.
output: He is verily potent over what He willeth, and in His grasp is the dominion of the entire creation.
prediction: Verily, He is the Potent over whatsoever He willeth, and in His grasp is the kingdom of creation.

input: و هو المقتدر العلیم الحکیم
output: He is the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.
prediction: He is the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise!

input: طوبی ثمّ طوبی لأرض فازت بقدومه و لعین قرّت بجماله و لسمع تشرّف باصغآء ندائه و لقلب ذاق حلاوة حبّه و لصدر رحب بذکره و لقلم تحرّک علی ثنائه و للوح حمل آثاره.
output: Blessed, doubly blessed, is the ground which His footsteps have trodden, the eye that hath been cheered by the beauty of His countenance, the ear that hath been honored by hearkening to His call, the heart that hath tasted the sweetness of His love, the breast that hath dilated through His remembrance, the pen that hath voiced His praise, the scroll that hath borne the testimony of His writings.
prediction: Great indeed, and great again, is the land that hath been honored with His advent, and the eye that hath been moistened with the splendor of His Beauty, and the ear that hath been exalted by hearkening to the call of His Voice, and the heart that hath tasted the sweetness of His Love, and the bosom that hath been broadened by His remembrance, and the pen that hath moved in lauding Him, and the Tablet that hath borne the tokens of His Presence.

input: نسأل الله تبارک و تعالی بأن یشرّفنا بلقائه قریباً انّه لهو السّامع المقتدر المجیب.
output: We beseech God—blessed and exalted be He—that He may honor us with meeting Him soon. He is, in truth, the All-Hearing, the All-Powerful, He Who is ready to answer.
prediction: We beseech God—blessed and glorified be He—that He may honor us with His meeting nigh, verily He is the Hearer, the All-Powerful, the Responder.
